name: Sunshine Task Force Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Sunshine Task Force
  Committee will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time and place,
  and will address the agenda listed below:

  City Hall
  455 North Rexford Drive
  4th
  Floor Conference Room A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Monday, January 28, 2019
  4:00 p.m.

  AGENDA

1)  Public Comment
  • Members of the public will be given an opportunity to directly address the Committee
  on items not listed on the agenda.

2)  Follow Up Items From the Last Meeting
  • Council direction not being followed/failure to follow the General Plan  —  Ronald
  Richards to provide suggestions on how to address issue

  •  Use of the discretionary process in planning

3)  Expanding the “Enforcement” section in the Commissions’ “Rules of Procedure”
  so that there is a clear and unambiguous 4-step process to remove a disruptive
  individual from a Commission meeting

4)  Adjournment

Posted: January 22, 2019

  In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, 4th Floor Conference Room A is wheelchair
accessible. If you need special assistance to attend this meeting, please call the City Manager’s Office at
(310) 285-1014 or TTY (310) 285-6881. Please notify the City Managers Office at least twenty-four (24)
  hours prior to the meeting if you requite captioning service so that reasonable arrangements can be
  made.
